messages:
maria-partnerships: Heads-up: CipherOps marketplace rehearsal scheduled Thu 11:00am PT. Primary goals: confirm SSO/SAML flow, finalize SCIM attribute mapping, validate BYOK/HSM test, and lock embargo window. Please reply with owner + one-line status by EOD. :spiral_calendar:
aj-security: I'll take SSO + SCIM verification. Quick status: SAML metadata exchanged and assertion validated in sandbox. SCIM endpoint lives but we still need attribute mapping for department/role/displayName. Will need CipherOps to confirm schema.
cipherops-jane: CipherOps update: SAML green in our staging. SCIM: endpoint ready, exposing core attributes. We'll share a mapping doc. HSM/BYOK: prototype flow works in our lab; marketplace harness integration pending. Expect to have a test key id by Tue.
ocipherops-ops: SCIM sample payload and test endpoint (will provide token):
```
POST https://scim.cipherops.example/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TEST_TOKEN>
{
  "userName": "a.lee@example.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Ava","familyName":"Lee"},
  "displayName": "Ava Lee",
  "emails": [{"value":"a.lee@example.com","primary":true}],
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User": {"department":"engineering","manager":"m.cam"},
  "custom:role": "platform-engineer"
}
```
maria-partnerships: Great. Ops asks for a cutover runbook + fallback plan in case BYOK/HSM fails at launch. @oliver-sre can you prepare RTO/RPO and rollback steps?
oliver-sre: Yep. Plan to draft runbook: pre-checks, canary traffic, quick switch to host-managed KMS if BYOK fails, and post-cutover verification checks. Need to know partner HSM vendor and whether HKDF key-wrap is in use. Also recommend a 30-minute maintenance window for the key rotation test.
sophia-marketing: Marketing needs embargo timing and final approved blurb and logos. Prefer 72h embargo before public announcement. Also need speaker list for the joint blog/webinar.
liam-legal: 72h embargo is ok tentatively; legal needs to review co-marketing addendum and DPA notes. Please provide logo in SVG and confirmation that no customer data will be displayed. I'll prepare the addendum template and route for signature.
aj-security: Action: I'll produce SCIM attribute checklist + SAML verification checklist by EOD.
cipherops-jane: We'll deliver the SCIM mapping doc and a BYOK test key id by Tue EOD. Also can provide a small video clip of the admin flow for the rehearsal.
deploy-bot: Reminder: After legal signs off, add announcement to marketplace-release calendar and create a release ticket in #release-war-room.
maria-partnerships: Summary of action items: aj-security: SCIM/SAML checklist; cipherops-ops: SCIM token + mapping doc + test key id; oliver-sre: runbook & fallback; liam-legal: draft addendum; sophia-marketing: embargo plan & speaker list. We'll do a 30m pre-rehearsal check 15m before the call. :thumbsup:
